newsitem.title: USA: Station Casinos sets casino expansion.
newsitem.headline: Station Casinos sets casino expansion.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc said on Monday it has signed several agreements to expand its Station Casinos Kansas City complex, adding movie theaters, nightclubs, restaurants, meeting rooms and arcades.
The expansion will add 900 new slot machines and 60 table games, boosting the property to 140,000 square feet of casino space with about 3,000 slots and 180 table games, the company said.

Act III Theatres will own and operate an 18-screen movie theater. Plans call for a jazz club, barbecue restaurant and microbrewery. New Horizon Kids Quest Inc will open a child care facility and an arcade will also be built.
A new 13,500 square-foot special events room will attract concerts and sporting events.

The cost of the expansion, excluding the theaters and gaming areas, is roughly $50 million, net of preopening costs and capitalized interest. The total cost of the Station Casinos Kansas City with the expansion is now $255 million.
Most of the expansion will be ready to open in December, subject to Missouri Gaming Commission approval. The movie theaters, arcade and microbrewery will open in April, 1997.
